listing.name: K-On! Houkago Live!! — KOn-Houkago-Live-Recompiled (EDGX73)
listing.summary: This is an early native-player release. Full-game compatibility has not been confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese ULJM05709 ISO, or the exact English fan translation specified by upstream and independently permitted for your use.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the release ZIP and use its executable to select your own ISO and generate the game locally. The precise English-translation version and hash are unconfirmed here; check upstream before using it.

warnings: This is an early native-player release. Full-game compatibility has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
